METALWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Metalwork related businesses, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork related businesses.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork related businesses.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork related businesses.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork related businesses.

2. When learning Forging, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Forging.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Forging.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Forging.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Forging.

3. When learning Surface Finishing Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Finishing Processes.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Finishing Processes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Surface Finishing Processes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Finishing Processes.

4. When learning Centre La, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Centre La.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Centre La.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Centre La.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Centre La.

5. When learning Gas Welding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Gas Welding.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Gas Welding.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Gas Welding.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Gas Welding.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

7. When learning Project 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 2.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 2.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project 2.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 2.

8. When learning Assembly Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawings.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawings.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawings.

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

11. When learning Heat treatment of steel, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Heat treatment of steel.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Heat treatment of steel.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Heat treatment of steel.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Heat treatment of steel.

12. When learning Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Surface Finishing Processes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Project 2 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Career Opportunities in Metalwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Metalwork related businesses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
